name: Chen, Xie, Maslov & Redner (2007): PageRank imported into citation analysis (scientific gems)
seed_rule: leakage-safe rule: seeds = the transfer paper's OpenAlex-indexed references whose primary_topic.topic is 'scientometrics and bibliometrics research' (the home side), published <= freeze_year, minus the targets; targets = the reference(s) that are the imported method's canonical paper(s) in the other field; freeze_year = transfer year - 1. OpenAlex labels the transfer paper 'Advanced Text Analysis Techniques' (wrong) and its field labels mix physics/CS/econ arbitrarily, so home = the bibliometrics topic shared by its citation-statistics references. OpenAlex dates the paper 2006 (online), so freeze_year = 2005 and Ball 2006 (Nature) drops out of the seeds.

targets.10.1016/s0169-7552(98)00110-x: Brin & Page 1998, The anatomy of a large-scale hypertextual Web search engine (PageRank)
targets.10.1145/324133.324140: Kleinberg 1999, Authoritative sources in a hyperlinked environment (HITS)
